mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy that increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors discount future cash flows at higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a 60-day negative S&P 500 return as recession fears intensify.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the current month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over 20 days as manufacturing slowdowns signal weakening economic activity and reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential construction permit index (HOUST) signals strong housing market activity, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a severe labor market deterioration, which causes a 60-day negative S&P 500 return as recession risks increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the current month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to the previous quarter signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
